amendment_policy.after_first_eligible_primary_observation: Any material change to source identity, timing, symbols, unit conversion, predictors, benchmark, outcome, metric, missing-data rule, or stopping rule creates a new protocol identity; V0 is preserved and never rewritten.
amendment_policy.before_first_eligible_primary_observatio: A material amendment requires a new version, byte preservation of this protocol, and independent review.

benchmark.definition: Trailing Binance Spot realized volatility from 720 hourly log returns ending at the last fully closed Monday 00:00 UTC boundary.
benchmark.forecast: The benchmark forecast is the formation-time trailing_30_day_realized_volatility_percent with zero fitted parameters.

forecast_comparison.dvol_forecast: The DVOL forecast is the accepted Deribit volatility numeric value in annualized percentage points; conversion to decimal for arithmetic is raw_value / 100. It has zero fitted parameters.
forecast_comparison.primary_metric_definition: For every complete asset-week, error is abs(forecast_percentage_points - outcome_realized_volatility_percentage_points). The sole primary metric is the equally asset-weighted pooled arithmetic mean across exactly 104 complete BTC weeks and 104 complete ETH weeks.
forecast_comparison.retention_rule: At the minimum sample, retain only if pooled DVOL mean absolute error is strictly lower than pooled benchmark mean absolute error and neither asset DVOL mean absolute error exceeds its benchmark. Otherwise classify KILLED. This is exploratory, not significance, power, causality, edge, or trading utility.

formation.acceptance_window: Monday 00:05:00.000 UTC through Monday 00:10:00.000 UTC inclusive
formation.completion_rule: The formation completion timestamp is max(accepted BTC DVOL source timestamp, accepted ETH DVOL source timestamp). Both values must be the first valid notification for their asset with source timestamp at or after the target and inside the acceptance window.
formation.no_last_known_value_rule: FORBIDDEN: a pre-target, stale, missing, later out-of-window, or substituted notification is invalid.

minimum_sample_and_stopping.sample_size_rationale: 104 paired weeks is a descriptive two-calendar-year target, not a power or significance calculation. 156 scheduled weeks is a finite three-year stop that permits frozen skipped-week handling.
minimum_sample_and_stopping.upper_review_rule: After scheduled week 156, classify BLOCKED if fewer than 104 complete paired weeks exist; otherwise apply the frozen terminal rule.

missing_data_and_retry_policy.allowed_retry: At most one reconnect and one resubscribe attempt may occur after a transport failure, both completed before 00:10:00.000 UTC. Attempts may not alter target, source timestamp rule, lookback cutoff, or outcome boundaries. Retain every sent request, acknowledgement, received message, local monotonic receipt time, UTC receipt time, error, and close reason as raw bytes or an explicit local operational record.
missing_data_and_retry_policy.record_rule: Every scheduled Monday produces exactly one retained status record. No status is silently dropped, imputed, replaced, or backfilled. A DECLARED_SKIPPED_WEEK is not an eligible observation. The 53rd declared skipped scheduled week classifies V0 as BLOCKED; collection may otherwise continue only within the 156-week cap.

outcome.annualization: sqrt(365 * 24); calculate decimal realized volatility then multiply by 100 for percentage points
outcome.definition: Binance Spot realized volatility over 168 strictly future one-hour log returns from BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT closed kline close prices.
outcome.end: The 169th boundary is Monday 01:00:00 UTC seven days after the first outcome boundary; retrieve only after its originating kline has closed.
outcome.first_boundary: Monday 01:00:00 UTC on the formation Monday
outcome.return_transform: natural logarithm of each consecutive pair of boundary close prices
outcome.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation of exactly 168 returns; no interpolation, forward fill, duplicate removal, or population estimator

primary_question: Does a timestamped Deribit DVOL observation produce lower forecast error than trailing Binance Spot realized volatility for future Binance Spot realized volatility?

binance_spot_klines.authentication: Public market data: endpoint security type is unspecified and therefore NONE.
binance_spot_klines.closure_rule: Accept only a row whose open_time_ms and close_time_ms match the declared UTC hour: close_time_ms = open_time_ms + 3600000 - 1. Retrieval occurs only after that close time. No current or incomplete kline is eligible.
binance_spot_klines.formation_lookback_retrieval: Allowed only at formation for each asset: one request with interval=1h, startTime=B-721h, endTime=B-1ms, limit=721, where B is Monday 00:00:00 UTC. Require exactly 721 chronological rows and retain raw response bytes. This is not primary-observation backfill.
binance_spot_klines.outcome_finalization_retrieval: Allowed only after outcome close for each registered week: one request with interval=1h, startTime=F-169h, endTime=F-1ms, limit=169, where F is the final Monday 01:00:00 UTC boundary. Require exactly 169 chronological rows and retain raw response bytes. This is not primary-observation backfill.
binance_spot_klines.pagination: FORBIDDEN AND UNNEEDED: 721 and 169 are each below the documented maximum 1000 rows.

deribit_dvol.authentication: Public market-data methods require no authentication.
deribit_dvol.connection: WebSocket public/subscribe; retain the subscription request and acknowledgement before accepting notifications. public/get_time may be retained solely as a clock-skew diagnostic, never as a substitute for notification source timestamps.
deribit_dvol.timestamp_semantics: data.timestamp is milliseconds since the Unix epoch; it is the authoritative formation source timestamp.
deribit_dvol.unit_and_horizon: Deribit DVOL is a 30-day forward-looking annualized implied-volatility expectation. Its numeric value is annualized percentage points; raw value 57 corresponds to about 3 percent daily using sqrt(365), so decimal conversion is raw_value / 100.

source_contract.rejected_architecture: DERIBIT_ONLY_PROSPECTIVE_STREAMS: rejected because a 30-day price-stream warm-up plus future stream collection and loss handling would be a larger persistent collector with more operational assumptions than bounded closed klines.
source_contract.selected_architecture_reason: The selected contract has explicit source timestamps for DVOL and explicit closed-kline open/close times for realized volatility, needs no pagination, preserves raw bytes, uses no fitted parameter, and remains experiment-specific.

terminal_classifications.BLOCKED: A required source, timestamp, raw-byte, integrity, complete outcome, or finite-schedule condition cannot be satisfied without a forbidden substitution or amendment.
terminal_classifications.KILLED: At the minimum complete sample, the DVOL forecast fails the frozen primary retention rule.
terminal_classifications.RETAIN_FOR_SEPARATELY_REGISTERED_FOLLOWU: At the minimum complete sample, DVOL meets the frozen primary rule. This is exploratory only and authorizes nothing further.

timing_integrity.outcome_begins_after_formation: Formation completes no later than Monday 00:10:00 UTC; the first measured outcome return starts Monday 01:00:00 UTC.
